'''Pergola's Bridge''' was a man-made bridge constructed by the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] as a crossing point of one of the [[Solleu River/Legends|Solleu River]].

==History==
Built by the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]], Pergola's Bridge was located on the [[Solleu River/Legends|Solleu River]] near some waterfalls that crested over the cliffs of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]]. A flat bridge, the crossing was built to ease the foot traffic over the ancient [[Bassa Bridge/Legends|Bassa Bridge]], which had begun to crumble from excessive use.<ref name="SWCL" />
